_doc: scientific_name values whose `sci` alias pointing at a DIFFERENT species row was found to be WRONG (distinct taxon, not a synonym). scripts.remerge_alias_dups deletes that alias instead of merging. Reviewed 2026-09-18.
Mimachlamys crassicostata: scallop ヒオウギガイ; alias pointed at Iris domestica ヒオウギ (cross-kingdom ja-homonym trap)
Salix matsudana: ペキンヤナギ is its own species; alias pointed at Salix subfragilis
Xanthium strumarium: オナモミ ≠ オオオナモミ (X. occidentale)
Erosa erosa: stonefish ダルマオコゼ; alias pointed at a cowrie (Monetaria caputserpentis)
Trachelospermum gracilipes: オキナワテイカカズラ kept distinct from T. asiaticum
Ranunculus grandis: シコタンキンポウゲ ≠ ウマノアシガタ (R. japonicus)
Aconitum iinumae: オオレイジンソウ ≠ エゾレイジンソウ (A. gigas)
Brassica nigra: クロガラシ; target row Hirschfeldia incana is itself mislabeled クロガラシ — do not fold
Debregeasia edulis: ヤナギイチゴ ≠ イワガネ (Oreocnide frutescens)
